args.command:
br create --title "Implement heartbeat file cleanup on shutdown" --description "Add the cleanup logic that removes heartbeat files when the shutdown handler is triggered.

Acceptance criteria:
- Heartbeat file path is accessible to the shutdown handler
- Cleanup code removes the heartbeat file using std::fs::remove_file
- Proper error handling — logged but doesn't panic on cleanup failure
- Cleanup is called from the shutdown signal handler

Depends on: bf-45nb (signal handler must be in place first)" --label split-child
args.description: Create second child bead for cleanup logic

output: bf-6acb

args.command:

Acceptance criteria:
- Test verifies heartbeat file is deleted when cleanup runs
- Test verifies cleanup handles missing file gracefully (no panic)
- Test verifies cleanup errors are logged correctly
- Tests cover both successful and failure scenarios

Depends on: bf-6acb (cleanup logic must exist before we can test it)" --label split-child
args.description: Create third child bead for unit tests

- Test verifies heartbeat file is removed after shutdown

- Test covers both normal exit and signal-triggered shutdown
